name: The Witch is No Good for You
source:
Bouquet in hand, Allin, an asexual succubus, arrives at the town formal hoping to surprise their girlfriend, only to find her in the arms of another! 

Will they seek solace (and scalding "I-told-you-so's") from their longtime friend? Or will they ignore the red flags just a moment longer?

[From [url=https://zacbytesgames.itch.io/witch-is-ng]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
手里拿着花束的无性魅魔阿林来到镇上的正式场合，希望给他们的女朋友一个惊喜，却发现她在另一个人的怀里！

他们会从他们的老朋友那里寻求安慰（并痛斥“我告诉过你了”）吗？或者他们会再忽视危险信号一会儿吗？

[来自[url=https://zacbytesgames.itch.io/witch-is-ng]itch.io[/url]]
